newsitem.title: USA: TECHNICAL DIFFICULTIES DELAY NYMEX ACCESS SESSION.
newsitem.headline: TECHNICAL DIFFICULTIES DELAY NYMEX ACCESS SESSION.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said Thursday its ACCESS after hours trading session has been delayed due to technical difficulties.
"We are delaying it because of technical difficulties, but it is unclear what specifically those difficulties are and how long the delay will be," said Maria Gonzalez, a NYMEX spokesperson.
The delay affects all NYMEX contracts that are traded after hours. The ACCESS overnight session runs from 1600 EDT to 0800 EDT the next day.
